subject.title: message_tool_only: one-shot delivery reminder loses to recency over long tool chains, turns end in withheld finals

question: For long `message_tool_only` turns that end with a substantive plain final, should OpenClaw add periodic in-turn delivery reminders, post-withhold recovery, or both?
rationale: The source path confirms the current one-time hint and warning-only suppression behavior, but choosing between reminder refresh and recovery affects prompt growth, duplicate-delivery risk, and the privacy contract.

options.title: Combine Reminder And Recovery
options.body: Add a fixed-size reminder after bounded tool activity and a one-shot recovery path for substantive private finals, coordinated with the active stranded-final recovery work.

options.title: Recovery Only
options.body: Repair missed finals after detection without adding more in-turn prompt traffic during long tool chains.

options.title: Reminder Only
options.body: Refresh the delivery instruction during long turns while leaving withheld-final retry or diagnostics to separate work.

recommendation.title: Combine Reminder And Recovery
recommendation.body: Add a fixed-size reminder after bounded tool activity and a one-shot recovery path for substantive private finals, coordinated with the active stranded-final recovery work.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses prompt policy, source-channel delivery, and private-final recovery, and current integration blame gives this the clearest owner signal.
